paper_title: Two-Sided Weak Submodularity for Matroid Constrained Optimization and Regression

context: Theorem 12 For any γ > 0 and k > 0 there exists a function on a ground set of size k that  is γ-weakly submodular from below but not β-weakly submodular from above for any β < k−γ k−1 = 1−γ  Θ k . Note that as γ → 0 (respectively γ → 1), we have β → k (respectively β → 1). Hence, we recover the trivial upper bound for monotone set functions when γ → 0 and as γ → 1, our lower bound on β approaches 1, corresponding to submodularity.
